d: The Warriors defeated the Magic, 126-119 tonight in Golden State. Stephen Curry contributed a team-high 41 points to go with 6 rebounds 6 assists and 5 three pointers, with Yaxel Lendeborg of the Warriors adding an additional 23 points (9-15 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Franz Wagner finished with a team-high 30 points along with 11 assists for the Magic in the losing effort. The Warriors improve their record to 7-3 with the win, while the Magic fall to 2-7 for the season.
